name: Above and Beyond

faq.answer: Duke Nicholas Zverenhoff is a commander contending with the undead horrors of the Plaguelands, directing travelers to strike down high-ranking officers of the Scourge.
Baron Rivendare is a powerful death knight serving the Lich King, commanding the legion of Scourge forces that occupy Stratholme.
Duke Nicholas Zverenhoff requires the severed head of Baron Rivendare as undeniable proof that the ruler of Stratholme has fallen.
faq.q: What proof does Duke Nicholas Zverenhoff demand?

sections.body: The burning streets of Stratholme teem with the walking dead, ruled from within by Baron Rivendare. To blunt the Scourge's power in the north, Duke Nicholas Zverenhoff seeks a champion willing to march into the ruin, defeat the dreaded lord, and deliver his head as proof.
sections.title: A Strike at Stratholme

summary: Duke Nicholas Zverenhoff calls on you to strike at the heart of the Scourge in the Plaguelands. The death knight Baron Rivendare commands Stratholme, and bringing back his severed head would break the undead hold over the ruined city.
attribution: In-game quest text: Above and Beyond
